title: Inter-Rater Agreement Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Explore how two reviewers' scores agree or disagree, then count the agreeing metrics and name the flagged metrics for three pairs of scores.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the number of agreeing metrics and name the flagged metrics for each of three pairs of reviewer scores, with at least 2 of 3 pairs fully correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The terms inter-rater agreement, agreeing metric, flagged metric, and percent agreement

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, commit an answer, and read the reason
keyQuestions: Which metrics differ by more than 3?
commonMisconceptions: Equal totals mean the reviewers agree
A difference of 3 points is flagged
assessmentOpportunities: Two scores are 5 and 9. Agree or flagged?
Two scores are 7 and 4. Agree or flagged?
Reviewer totals are both 65. Do the reviewers agree?
Seven of ten metrics agree. What is the percent agreement?

controls.name: Ten sliders
controls.description: in explore mode, set Reviewer 2's scores from 0 to 10 in whole points. They start equal to Reviewer 1's.

controls.name: Agreeing metrics box
controls.description: type a whole number from 0 to 10.

controls.name: Ten metric buttons and None flagged
controls.description: mark every flagged metric, or choose None flagged.

controls.name: Check
controls.description: commits the answer. Back to explore is on the results screen.
